impacts.migration: Additive PostgreSQL migration 006. Existing athletes are backfilled as Athlete principals. No historical migration is modified.
impacts.security: Authentik remains authentication boundary. x-sam-target-athlete is an untrusted selector; DB assignment is authoritative. Coach writes to Athlete-authored subjective surfaces are denied.
impacts.compatibility: Unknown existing Authentik subjects continue to self-provision as Athletes. Coaches must be provisioned by an operator before first Coach use.

rollback: Application code can be rolled back while retaining additive authorization tables; do not edit/reverse migration 006. A later forward migration is required if schema rollback is ever necessary.
residualRisks: Production Authentik/Coolify end-to-end deployment verification remains part of VI-007/#27, not VI-001.
